title: Roadmap and Milestones
guidingQuestion: How do we steer technology with society instead of forever reacting?
summary: A shared long-term roadmap and milestones so Meta-Layer development is proactive, coordinated, and publicly legible.

hero.headline: Shared direction beats perpetual scramble.
hero.text: Without a public roadmap, communities only respond after harms scale. Milestones make progress visible and invite coordinated contribution.

problemStory.title: Why this matters
problemStory.scenario: A new capability ships globally before schools, laws, or communities have language for it. Debate starts after deployment, when reversing course is hardest.

webLimitations.title: Why today's Web struggles
webLimitations.text: Product roadmaps are private competitive assets. Public-interest coordination lacks a durable, shared planning surface.

futureVision.title: Imagine instead
futureVision.text: Communities co-maintain a living roadmap with milestones anyone can track, critique, and help deliver.
bullets: Space for foresight, not only incident response
